name: Montréal
recommended_geography: Quartiers sociologiques or quartiers de référence en habitation; choose one and document the grain before implementation
feasibility: revenue-capable with Montréal-specific tax-bill semantics; not Edmonton-equivalent without careful tax-line filtering
summary: Montréal has strong official open data for property/tax bill lines, evaluation-unit geometry, boundaries, roads, cycling, transit, and parking. A first revenue/value adapter should aggregate published municipal tax-account lines to neighbourhood geography, but must disclose that this is a first-issuance tax-bill-line model and not a clean Edmonton-style municipal levy reconstructed from an assessment roll plus simple mill rates.
privacy: Published role/tax files include evaluation-unit IDs, account numbers, civic addresses, street names, unit ranges, matricules, taxable values, and tax amounts. Québec role-foncier rules limit public consultation patterns; never ship raw parcel/account/address/matricule web artifacts. Aggregate to neighbourhood/borough or a privacy-safe grid before publishing.

boundaries.title: Quartiers sociologiques
boundaries.caveat: Alternative official geography is Quartiers de référence en habitation (`quartiers`, package id f38c91a1-e33f-4475-a112-3b84b1c60c1e). Pick one canonical geography and avoid mixing them.

administrative_boundaries.title: Limites administratives de l'agglomération de Montréal (arrondissements et villes liées)
administrative_boundaries.caveat: Needed for borough-level tax files and rate semantics; not a neighbourhood-equivalent by itself.

assessment_units.title: Unités d'évaluation foncière
assessment_units.caveat: Contains evaluation-unit geometry and general attributes, not a complete value/tax roll. Condominiums may overlap on the same location; some modified matricules use temporary 2m x 2m geometries.

tax_bill_lines.title: Imposition annuelle de taxes municipales
tax_bill_lines.caveat: This is an extraction of each annual tax line composing the first issued tax account. Some personal fields are excluded, but address/account fields remain sensitive. The catalogue explicitly says it is not exhaustive City revenue data; later adjustments/exceptions may be absent. Use `ID_CUM` to join to evaluation units and aggregate early.

tax_rates.title: Taux de taxation et tarification
tax_rates.caveat: Useful for rate semantics and QA, but the catalogue metadata seen during research referenced older temporal coverage; verify currentness before relying on it. Montréal taxes include general property tax, water, road, ARTM contribution, borough taxes, and sector/property-type exceptions.

roads.title: Géobase - réseau routier
roads.caveat: Road-centreline equivalent; verify field names and filter destroyed/planned/non-road segments before length metrics.

bike.title: Réseau cyclable
bike.caveat: Filter to current/built cycling infrastructure. REV package (`reseau-express-velo`) can be a context/subtype layer, not a replacement for the full cycling network.

transit.title: STM horaires planifiés et trajets des bus et du métro
transit.caveat: STM service only. If regional commuter rail/REM/exo/ARTM coverage is required, use additional regional feeds and document operator scope.

parking.title: Stationnements municipaux tarifés, sur rue et hors rue
parking.caveat: Includes paid municipal on-street and off-street parking places/rules. It is not an Edmonton-style city-managed parkade/surface-lot capacity inventory unless off-street rows and capacities can be separated defensibly.

zoning_land_use.title: Land-use proxy from CUBF/use codes plus urban-plan layers; no single current citywide parcel zoning open dataset verified
zoning_land_use.caveat: Treat as land-use/use-classification proxy, not legal zoning. Montréal borough zoning can be more restrictive and may live in borough-specific/interactive planning systems.

population.title: Commande personnalisée - Recensement 2021
population.format: Beyond 20/20 / tabular resources; confirm exact table before implementation
population.licence: Statistics Canada Open Licence / Open Government Licence terms per catalogue
population.caveat: Research saw 2021 census custom tables at agglomeration, city, and arrondissement scales. Neighbourhood-level population for chosen quartiers may require dissemination-area/block apportionment from Statistics Canada boundaries. Older Montréal 2011 neighbourhood resources exist but should not be used as current denominator data.

repo_module_mapping.download: Add a Montréal city adapter/config instead of extending Edmonton Socrata assumptions in scripts/download_data.py.
repo_module_mapping.assessment_and_tax: New loader should join taxes-municipales ID_CUM to unites-evaluation-fonciere geometry, filter tax line categories explicitly, and aggregate to chosen quartiers before web export.
repo_module_mapping.boundaries: New boundary loader for quartiers-sociologiques or quartiers de référence; document and test feature count/name stability.
repo_module_mapping.roads: New road loader for geobase, replacing Edmonton centreline fields with Montréal field mapping.
repo_module_mapping.bike: New bike loader for pistes-cyclables/REV subtype handling.
repo_module_mapping.transit: GTFS ZIP loader for STM, optionally regional feeds if scope expands.
repo_module_mapping.parking: New parking loader for municipal paid parking places/rules, with off-street/on-street separation and no capacity invention.
repo_module_mapping.zoning: Use CUBF land-use categories or verified borough/city zoning layers; do not reuse Edmonton zoning classifier.
